changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Image Captioning' as the task is not traditional image captioning but referential game communication. Removed dataset size details as they are implementation details rather than the dataset itself. Added 'Artificial emergent language' to languages field. Normalized spelling and capitalization.
Removed 'average DDL' and 'DDL:GDL ratio' as they are variations/calculations of the core metrics. Normalized metric names to proper capitalization.
No LLM-based evaluation is used in this paper. The paper focuses on grammar induction techniques (CCL, DIORA, BMM) for analyzing emergent languages.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The evaluation is entirely automated using grammar induction and analysis techniques.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on analyzing the syntactic structure of emergent languages from referential games using unsupervised grammar induction techniques. The NLG aspect is indirect - it evaluates the communication protocols that emerge between AI agents, not traditional NLG tasks. The automatic metrics used are specialized for grammar analysis rather than standard NLG evaluation metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some implementation details that were better suited for removal.
